items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I like the fact that if you listen to those, the little figures that Fletcher Henderson or Horace Henderson did as backgrounds to the soloists, I think they are wonderful by themselves

ctx.x: No. I’m not. But it did occur to me that with the big band the last couple of nights, playing the tunes from that era, the 30s and stuff, that the solid rhythm underneath this [scats] those horn parts are so syncopated and that the wonderful, smooth sort of tension it creates is just astounding.

Yeah, exactly. And I like the fact that if you listen to those, the little figures that Fletcher Henderson or Horace Henderson did as backgrounds to the soloists, I think they are wonderful by themselves, just listening to those background figures. They’re very nice.
And they’re really tricky to play.
